title: Completeness and norm of complex l1 families
statement: Let $I$ be any set, including the empty set. Write $\ell^1(I,\mathbf C)$ for the set of families $u:I\to\mathbf C$ for which $\sum_{i\in I}|u_i|$ is summable, where summability means convergence of the net of finite subsums and absolute value is [def-weil-complex-absolute-value]. With coefficientwise addition and complex scalar multiplication and the norm $\|u\|_1=\sum_{i\in I}|u_i|$, this is a normed complex vector space and is complete: every Cauchy sequence for the metric $\|u-v\|_1$ converges to an element of $\ell^1(I,\mathbf C)$.
